long_biography.plain_text:
After studying economics and history at Tufts University, Gaurav Burman worked in business development at Dabur and helped form international joint ventures. He later joined Dresdner's private equity team in London and New York. That experience preceded his founding of Elephant Capital, a listed investment fund focused on growing businesses connected with India.

His subsequent work has brought overseas companies into partnerships with Indian businesses, including ventures involving insurance, credit information and restaurants. This combines experience of investing with the practical work of developing commercial relationships. Burman has maintained ties to his university through its International Board of Advisors, contributing to an institution that helped shape his education.
